verdict.rationale: Finix's docs show Dashboard-or-API parity for several core workflows: seller payouts, disputes, payout links and webhook management. However, no doc claims full API/UI parity. Some capabilities are described only as Dashboard features, such as manual card entry, notification settings and automated reports. Missing for 10: an explicit API-parity commitment, documented API equivalents for Dashboard-only features (reports, notification settings, manual payments), and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: You can manage how sellers get paid out using the Finix Dashboard or our API.
Monitor and act on Disputes through the Finix Dashboard or API.
Learn how to create payout links on the Finix Dashboard and via API
Finix also supports creating and updating webhooks through the Finix Dashboard.
